an1.11:1.1: “Feature of beauty” is _subhanimitta_. In early Pali, _nimitta_ is used for a feature or quality of the mind that, when focused on, promotes the growth of similar or related qualities. Thus focusing on beauty fosters the desire for that beauty.
an1.11:1.2: To “apply the mind irrationally” is to use your mind so as to produce the opposite effect than that desired.
